text:
sofia: Heads-up — Cerulean Labs onboarding showing p95 tail increase after yesterday's model pin. p95 ~2.4s (was ~1.0s). Traffic: ~80% short chat, a few long-context jobs. Proactive suggestion: run a 5% canary routing to a compact int4 model, enable prefix cache on short-chat route, and reduce max_batch_wait_ms for that route. Need SE + SRE signoff before changing routing.
derek: Link to dashboard and token distro?
sofia: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/cerulean/onboarding-latency
sofia: Token distro: 80% <80 tokens, 18% 80-512, 2% >512. Spike correlates with a partner integration increasing concurrency. No error increase.
fran: Sounds like batching pressure. Plan: (1) canary 5% -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, (2) enable prefix/KV cache for short-chat route with short TTL, (3) set max_batch_wait_ms=6 for that route, (4) fallback to original model on 3 consecutive p95 breaches.
sofia: I can run the canary and notify the customer. SEs, please draft the route override and short eval set (10 prompts covering their main flows).
derek: Draft override snippet below. Recommend client add a tiny retry too.
```yaml
route: /v1/chat/completions
canary_percent: 5
model: redwood-compact-13b-int4
overrides:
  batching:
    max_batch_wait_ms: 6
  cache:
    prefix_cache: true
    ttl_ms: 30000
```
derek: Eval gating: 10 prompts, abort if semantic score drops >2%.
fran: I'll enable tracing on top-3 endpoints and add an autoscale guard. deploy-bot, schedule a 20m canary at 09:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: start=5350002000 (09:00 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=sofia. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`
sofia: Notifying Cerulean: "We will run a 20-minute canary at 09:00 UTC to test a compact model + caching on short-chat traffic; no downtime expected. We'll share p50/p95, KV hit rates, and eval deltas within 30 minutes after the run." Will update thread with results.
